caption: Cross-correlation between AR(1) pre-whitened SOX and SPY daily returns at lags -20..+20. The y-axis is clipped to the lead/lag scale so the small significant cells are legible; the dominant lag-0 co-movement (0.709, shaded grey) runs off the top and is annotated with its true value. The residual significant cells fall on BOTH the lead side (6 cells) and the lag side (7 cells). This symmetric mass is the visual signature of bidirectional feedback, not a clean semiconductor lead.
narrative_alignment_note: CCF chart conveys bidirectional feedback; lag-0 flagged as co-movement.
